Design Review Checklist

Each section below is a check the design review makes before a design history file is released. Each one is a live query block (provenance-ddf DES-0032) asking for what would fail the check, so an empty section is a passed check. The same queries are the project's rules in rules/, which provenance validate runs at the merge gate (DES-0016): what a rule reports is exactly what its section here lists.
